prompt: 幫城市 as-twn-taipei（變體 orig）跑「LLM 網絡循環」——與該泳道上的程式網絡循環（移點-移線-移枝-併格）並存，另餵 Frame（compact=llm-network-loop）。起點＝系統已清掉舊循環檔後的 LLM 直線化結果（該鏈檔的 align 子物件，取值一律 alignOf(doc)）；缺對齊先停、不要自己亂起點。反覆 export → 分析 → apply 迭代到收斂（上限 10 輪）；每輪 moves.json 含 model 與 note，第一輪附 prompt。目標：在硬規則內提高 H/V、壓縮空欄空列、縮短路線。完成後只輸出 HV／格網尺寸前後與一句總結。

transcript.note: Round 1 — build a shared column and close a dangling diagonal. Vertices 44, 40, 23, 12, 38, 13, 2, 18, 20, 45 and 33 are each pinned on both axes by two or more existing H/V segments, so the only movable hubs are 36, 58 and the degree-2 terminus 7. Moved 36 (30,30)->(25,30) and 58 (33,34)->(25,34), which keeps 36-44 and 58-24 horizontal (rows unchanged) while stacking 36, 58 and 16 on column 25 — that turns both 36-58 and 58-16 into verticals. It trades away the 45-degree 45-36, 36-23 and 44-58, which is the right trade because the score is lexicographic on H/V first and 45-degree only as a tie-break. Moved terminus 7 (1,46)->(1,42) rather than moving 11: it keeps 7-48 vertical on column 1, turns 11-7 into a horizontal that now runs collinear with 15-11 as one straight east-west spine on row 42, and it vacates row 46 so compaction can drop that band. Winding order re-checked by atan2 at 36, 58 and 16 — unchanged in all three; 7 and 11 are degree 2 and exempt.
transcript.noteZh: 第 1 輪——做出一條共用直行並收掉一條懸空的斜段。頂點 44、40、23、12、38、13、2、18、20、45、33 每一個都被兩條以上既有 H/V 段在兩軸上釘死，真正可動的樞紐只有 36、58 與度數 2 的端點站 7。把 36 從 (30,30) 移到 (25,30)、58 從 (33,34) 移到 (25,34)：兩者的列都沒變，所以 36-44 與 58-24 兩條水平段原封保住，而 36、58、16 疊到同一欄 25，使 36-58 與 58-16 雙雙變成垂直段。代價是放掉 45-36、36-23、44-58 三條 45 度；這個交換是划算的，因為評分是先比 H/V、45 度只當同分時的決勝條件。端點站 7 從 (1,46) 移到 (1,42)（而不是改動 11）：這樣 7-48 仍然是欄 1 上的垂直段，11-7 變成水平段並與 15-11 共線成為列 42 上一條筆直的東西向主軸，同時空出列 46 讓壓縮把那一條帶拿掉。已用 atan2 逐一複查 36、58、16 的環繞序，三者皆未改變；7 與 11 度數為 2，不在檢查範圍。

transcript.note: Round 2 — two rigid-group translations, because after round 1 every endpoint of every remaining unaligned segment is pinned on both axes by two or more H/V segments, so no single-vertex move can gain anything. (a) Slid the whole row-12 group 40, 17, 34, 55 down one row to row 13 as a rigid unit: all of its internal H/V survives (17-34, 34-55 stay horizontal on the new row; 40-10, 17-22, 17-30, 55-32 stay vertical because their columns are untouched), and 44-40 closes into a horizontal on row 13 next to 36-44. It vacates row 12 for compaction. (b) Slid the column-15 pair 38, 12 three columns east to column 18, where 13 already sits: 38-12 stays vertical, 38-18, 23-12 and 22-12 stay horizontal because the rows are untouched, and 13-38 closes into a vertical — column 18 now reads as one clean north-south trunk 21-6-13-38-12 with no station swallowed between 13 and 38. It vacates column 15. Both translations cost the single remaining 45-degree segment 40-12, which is the correct trade under the lexicographic score. Winding order re-checked by atan2 at every moved vertex and at each of their unmoved neighbours 10, 22, 30, 12, 44, 23, 18, 40 — unchanged everywhere; 34, 55 and 32 are degree 2 and exempt. Left alone as structurally impossible: 38-23, 36-23, 45-36, 44-58, 23-20, 16-33 and 2-18, each of which is the third side of a triangle whose other two sides are already H/V, or would swallow station 37 if forced vertical.
transcript.noteZh: 第 2 輪——兩組剛體平移。第 1 輪之後，剩下每一條未對齊段的兩個端點都被兩條以上 H/V 段在兩軸釘死，單點移動已經一分都拿不到。(a) 把整條列 12 的群組 40、17、34、55 當成剛體往下移一列到列 13：群組內部的 H/V 全數存活（17-34、34-55 在新的一列上仍是水平；40-10、17-22、17-30、55-32 因為欄沒動而仍是垂直），而 44-40 收成列 13 上的水平段，緊接在 36-44 之後；同時空出列 12 供壓縮。(b) 把欄 15 的一對 38、12 往東移三欄到欄 18，也就是 13 所在的那一欄：38-12 仍是垂直，38-18、23-12、22-12 因為列沒動而仍是水平，13-38 收成垂直——欄 18 現在成為一條乾淨的南北主幹 21-6-13-38-12，且 13 與 38 之間沒有吞掉任何車站；同時空出欄 15。兩次平移的代價都是僅存的那條 45 度段 40-12，在先比 H/V 的字典序評分下這是正確的取捨。已用 atan2 逐一複查每個被移動頂點、以及它們未移動的鄰居 10、22、30、12、44、23、18、40 的環繞序，全部未變；34、55、32 度數為 2，不在檢查範圍。刻意不動的是結構上做不到的 38-23、36-23、45-36、44-58、23-20、16-33 與 2-18：它們各自是某個三角形的第三邊，而該三角形另外兩邊已經是 H/V；或者強行拉成垂直會吞掉車站 37。
